page.layout: Running head at top left: page number "82". Running title at top centre. Below it, two round portrait medallions with circular legends (left: Romulus, right: Hersilia), set side by side. Below them one column of running text, then one paragraph on Hersilia, then an italic verse passage. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: ROMVLVS
HERSILIA. SABIN
ROMVLVS Romanorum Rex primus, imperauit anno
mundi 3212. ante Christum natum 750. filius fuit Rheæ Iliæ
Vestalis,quem vnà cum Remo,vnico partu edidit, qui paruuli
prope ripam Tyberis expositi, tamen à Faustulo ad Accâ Lau-
rentiam delati sunt: vbi adoleuerunt,collecta pastorum manu,
Amulium interfecerunt,& Numitorem auum in regnum resti
tuerunt, qui pulsus fuerat à fratre suo Amulio minore natu.
Poftea vrbê ædificant vbi fuerant expositi, quæ Roma dicta est
à conditoris nomine Romulo:qui Remũ fratrem occidit,quòd
ludibrio & quasi per contemptum Romuli, nouos transiluisset
muros : cẽtum senatores creat Romulus, qui Patres ab honore,
Patricij eorũ progenies appellati.300. armatos ad custodiâ cor-
poris,quos Celeres appellauit,non in bello solùm,sed etiam in
pace habuit.ex Sabinis & Rom.vnicam gentem fecit.post sub-
actos Ceninenses, Antemnates, Crustuminos, Fidenates, Ve-
ientes, cum ad recensendum exercitum concionem in campo
haberet,subitò orta tempestate,cum fragore & tonitribus,tam
denso opertus est nimbo , vt conspectum eius concioni abstu-
lerit tempestas , nec deinde in terris sit visus. imperauit annos
37.Vide Tit.Liu.li.1.Diony.Halicar.lib.2. & Eutro.lib.1.
HERSILIA, vxor fuit Romuli,de qua Ti.Li.1.deca.1.De
hac nonnihil fabulatur etiam Ouidius,ad calcem 14.lib.Meta-
morph. inquiens:

l.i: Flebat vt amissum coniux, cùm regia Iuno
Irin ad Herfiliam descendere limite curuo
Imperat : & vacuæ sua sic mandata referre: O
& de Latio, ò & de gente Sabina
Ante fuiffe viri coniux,nunc eff. Quirini,

page.notes: Two round portrait medallions (engravings) with circular legends; the legends are transcribed above as printed: left "ROMVLVS" (read around the medallion, with "R O" at lower left), right "HERSILIA." and "SABIN" (end of legend possibly cut off by the engraving edge). The verse line "Irin ad Herfiliam" is printed as such. In line 5, the word "decus" and "dignissima" have missing ink; the letter is marked [?]. "coniux" in line 6 has a gap after "co", read as coniux. Printed spacing of "3212" and "750" in the text is irregular, copied as the number. Possible printing errors left as printed: "Vide Tit.Liu.li.1" and "Herfiliam" in the quotation.
